content:
emily: Starting HelixPay QBR thread. Meeting Fri 6/9 11am PT. Need final deck, one-slide renewal recommendation, and a 60s enablement clip. Who owns the deck?

marco: Ill take deck owner. Will combine usage, onboarding, and cost trends. Please share any recent support trends.

rachel: Ill own enablement + adoption narrative. Need playbook run counts and workshop attendance.

tom: Ill handle exec invites + procurement ask. VP wants a single ask; prefer committed term. Can we draft two options but lead with one?

vivian: Noting renewal signal: two pilot seats paused, support mentions "inconsistent throughput". Ill draft the risk slide + remediation timeline.

cs-bot: Renewal score 58; onboarding completion 68%.

marco: Action items:
```
- marco: deck (due Tue 6/6)
- rachel: enablement slide + 60s clip (due Mon 6/5)
- vivian: renewal ask + remediation plan (due Mon 6/5)
- tom: confirm exec attendance (due Fri 6/2)
- all: review draft by Thu 6/8
```

emily: Demo plan: live core flow + recorded fallback for heavy rerank. Marco, confirm demo env token limits.

marco: Confirmed. Will paste health snapshot and a short latency chart.

rachel: Ill prepare a 90s enablement vignette showing faster time-to-value.

vivian: Draft ask: 12mo commit at 15% off + two enablement workshops. Sharing language shortly.

emily: Pre-brief with VP Thurs 6/8 30m. Who can do the pre-brief?

rachel: Ill join the pre-brief for adoption talking points.

emily: Great team. Draft deck link please once uploaded and well run final dry run Thu 6/8 4pm PT. Thanks :white_check_mark:
